# Introduction

Galdr tables are base structures used for crafting and repairing Mistlands and Ashlands gear relating to magic. They require a roof and 70% cover to be usable. Repairing items does not cost any resources.

## Upgrades

Upgrading a Galdr table enables additional crafting recipes and higher upgrade levels for items. A Galdr table can be upgraded up to level 4 by building the following structures near it:

• Name: Rune table | Materials: 10 Black marble5 Yggdrasil wood10 Refined eitr

• Name: Unfading candles | Materials: 10 Black marble3 Skeleton trophy10 Refined eitr15 Resin

• Name: Feathery wreath | Materials: 8 Celestial Feather1 Asksvin trophy10 Refined eitr3 Ashwood
